observations: Three photos show the same black electronic keyboard lying on artificial grass.
Photo 2 shows 'YAMAHA Portasound' text clearly printed on the lower left of the control panel.
Photo 0 shows 'YAMAHA Professional' text near the top left, and a partially visible model code that is too blurry to read.
Keyboard has roughly 32-37 keys, a row of sliders, buttons labeled 'MULTI MENU', 'ORCHESTRA', 'AUTO BASS CHORD', and a small LCD-type display.
No power cable, adapter, or batteries are visible in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on, display lit, or any indicator active.
Surface shows normal used-item wear (scuffs, some faded print) but no visible cracks or missing keys.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'MARY OLUGBAMI' overlay the images, consistent with a resale listing screenshot.
